Our Story

Farm to Skin. Made in Africa.

ORÍKÌ Group is the first and only all-natural farm-to-skin brand in Nigeria to operate a luxury wellness spa chain alongside its own product line — a distinctive universe of skincare, spas, manufacturing, training and technology.

We work relentlessly to put Africa on the map in the global skincare & wellness industry, and to popularise African Beauty — A Beauty.
